onTheRecord.finding: David H. Koch Charitable Foundation (990-PF, FY2024, filed Nov 14 2025): revenue $154,030, charitable disbursements $2,108,295, total assets $1,512,449 (liabilities $200,000, net assets $1,312,449). FY2023: disbursements $629,848, net assets $3,471,344. Foundation has received $0 contributions since FY2011 and net assets have wound down from $10.2M (2019) to $1.3M (2024). Officers uncompensated.

Julia Koch Family Philanthropy Fund (EIN 87-3659591, Wichita KS) is a 501(c)(4) social-welfare organization (donations not tax-deductible), not a private foundation; files Form 990, not 990-PF. FY2024: contributions $78.9M, expenses $22.6M, net assets $92.0M. FY2023: contributions $101.9M, expenses $91.1M, total liabilities $33.0M; FY2023 return includes Schedule L (reported conflict-of-interest / interested-party transactions). Julia F. Koch is a director, uncompensated.
Not on the Giving Pledge full signatory list (checked 2026-09-27; list modified 2026-07-29). No Koch family member appears.
